SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  Attributes['cpu'] AS cpu,
  Attributes['mode'] AS mode,
  max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'node-exporter'
  AND MetricName = 'node_cpu_seconds_total'
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, cpu, mode
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  MetricName,
  avg(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE ServiceName = 'node-exporter'
  AND MetricName IN ('node_load1', 'node_load5', 'node_load15')
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, MetricName
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  MetricName,
  avg(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE ServiceName = 'node-exporter'
  AND MetricName IN ('node_memory_Active_bytes', 'node_memory_Cached_bytes', 'node_memory_Buffers_bytes')
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, MetricName
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 second) AS time,
  Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mount,
  avg(Value) AS available
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE ServiceName = 'node-exporter'
  AND MetricName = 'node_filesystem_avail_bytes'
  AND Attributes['fstype'] NOT IN ('tmpfs', 'overlay')
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, mount
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  Attributes['device'] AS device,
  max(Value) AS bytes
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'node-exporter'
  AND MetricName = 'node_network_receive_bytes_total'
  AND Attributes['device'] NOT LIKE 'veth%'
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, device
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  Attributes['container'] AS container,
  max(Value) AS cpu_seconds
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'kubernetes-cadvisor'
  AND MetricName = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total'
  AND Attributes['container'] != ''
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, container
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  Attributes['container'] AS container,
  avg(Value) AS memory
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE ServiceName = 'kubernetes-cadvisor'
  AND MetricName = 'container_memory_working_set_bytes'
  AND Attributes['container'] != ''
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, container
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace,
  Attributes['pod'] AS pod,
  Attributes['phase'] AS phase,
  max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE ServiceName = 'kube-state-metrics'
  AND MetricName = 'kube_pod_status_phase'
  AND Value = 1
  AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
GROUP BY namespace, pod, phase
ORDER BY namespace, pod

SELECT
  Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace,
  Attributes['deployment'] AS deployment,
  MetricName,
  max(Value) AS replicas
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE ServiceName = 'kube-state-metrics'
  AND MetricName IN ('kube_deployment_spec_replicas', 'kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready')
  AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
GROUP BY namespace, deployment, MetricName
ORDER BY namespace, deployment
